base ordinals ∈ [0, N)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="145" x="885" y="62" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="yamlbox" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="# dataset.yaml (BQGD view)
profiles:
 default:
 maxk: 100
 base_vectors: profiles/base/base_vectors.fvecs
 query_vectors: profiles/base/query_vectors.fvecs
 neighbor_indices: profiles/default/neighbor_indices.ivecs
 neighbor_distances: profiles/default/neighbor_distances.fvecs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="450" x="40" y="505" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="invbox" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Ordinal referencing invariants
• ordinals are implicit — a record's ordinal is its position; row order is load-bearing
• B and Q are independent ordinal spaces; G is the only bridge between them
• row alignment: |G| = |Q| — record i of G describes query ordinal i
• value reference: every cell v of G is a base ordinal, 0 ≤ v < |B|
• G row width k ≤ maxk; values ordered nearest → farthest
• D (neighbor_distances.fvecs) is cell-for-cell aligned with G — one distance per neighbor cell
(spec: docs/sysref/01-data-model.md §1.5–1.6)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="160" width="560" x="540" y="505" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Ordinal referencing invariants
• ordinals are implicit — a record's ordinal is its position; row order is load-bearing
• B and Q are independent ordinal spaces; G is the only bridge between them
• row alignment: |G| = |Q| — record i of G describes query ordinal i
• value reference: every cell v of G is a base ordinal, 0 ≤ v < |B|
• G row width k ≤ maxk; values ordered nearest → farthest
• D (neighbor_distances.fvecs) is cell-for-cell aligned with G — one distance per neighbor cell
(spec: docs/sysref/01-data-model.md §1.5–1.6)
